Sandbox_IAmBruceLeeNow_CraftableHandwrap: When enabled, survivors who have read Kung Fu Magazine can craft Bruce Lee Handwraps. Disabled by default. Guaranteed police-station handwraps are unaffected.
Sandbox_IAmBruceLeeNow_MartialArtsMuscle: Controls muscle strain from martial-arts combinations. 0%% disables it, 100%% uses the mod's standard rate, 200%% doubles it, and 300%% triples it. The game's Muscle Strain Factor still applies.
Sandbox_IAmBruceLeeNow_MartialArtsXpMult: Multiplies Martial Arts XP earned from successful strikes.
